scientific_integrity: The general Gaussian-mixture method and original finite-chain numerical non-Gaussian observations are prior work, not claimed new. The claims are a strict network-wide if-and-only-if classification, clock-variance formula and universal covariance-matched Gaussian comparison, with an analytic proof and auxiliary exact tests.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional exponentially stable real linear systems, independent positive-rate Poisson reset clocks and positive-diffusivity Brownian bath excursions, independent thermal Gaussians, and instantaneous linear readouts only. No thermodynamic-limit uniform lower bound, no nonlinear energy-current theorem and no extension to non-Poisson resetting is proved.
title: Gaussian-projection rigidity for linear systems driven by Poisson-reset Brownian baths
